answer: Bonded identities post collateral, while signed equivocation proofs connect coordinated keys along a thread of conflicting messages. For k identities participating in correlated equivocation, the protocol aggregates attributable violations and scales penalties as O(k^2), rather than treating each key as an isolated incident. A detected sybil swarm therefore faces an exponential multiplier in capital loss; escrowed bonds form a trellis of enforceable claims, leaving no haven in mere key proliferation.
